dashboard.welcome: Nau mai, haere mai ki EncodeX
dashboard.subtitle: Tāu taputapu katoa-i-te-tahi mō te huripoka, te whakatika me te kōmitimiti i te oro, te ataata me te whakaahua.
dashboard.descConvert: Whakaputaina te ataata me te oro me te whakahaere i te codec, te mārama me te kounga
dashboard.descMediaInfo: Tirohia ngā taipitopito codec, ngā ia me te ipu
dashboard.descImage: Kōmitimiti ngā whakaahua me te whakahaere i te hōputu, te kounga me te rahinga
dashboard.descAudio: Tohaina te oro mā mai i ngā kōnae ataata
dashboard.descCut: Tapahia te ataata me te tika ki te āma
dashboard.descBatch: Huripokia ngā kōnae maha i te wā kotahi me te rārangi mōhio

closeConfirm.title: Katia te EncodeX?
closeConfirm.message: Kei te haere tonu ētahi mahi, ā, he huringa kāore anō kia penapenahia. Ka whakakorehia ina katia ināianei.

convert.title: Huripokia te Pāpāho
convert.noFile: Kāore anō kia tīpakohia he kōnae
convert.noOutput: Kāore anō kia tīpakohia te putanga
convert.cancelMessage: Kei te tino hiahia koe ki te whakakore i te huripoka o nāianei?
convert.jobCancelMessage: Mā tēnei e muku te mahi huripoka o nāianei. Kei te tino mōhio koe?
convert.hardwareAccelAlert: Kua whakahohehia te whakatere marohi. Mā te whakawaehere ataata e whakamahi tō GPU inā hototahi.
convert.inputFileHint: Te kōnae pāpāho puna hei huripoka. Ko ngā hōputu noa ko MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, MP3 me WAV.
convert.dropLabel: Whakatakotoria he kōnae pāpāho ki konei, ka pāwhiri rānei ki te tirotiro
convert.outputFileHint: Te ara whāinga e tiakina ai te kōnae kua huripokahia.
convert.losslessCopyHint: Kapehia ngā ia kāore he whakawaehere anō. Tere, kore-ngaro, engari me tautoko te ipu putanga i te codec puna.
convert.videoCodecHint: Ko te codec e whakamahia ana hei whakawaehere i te ia ataata, hei tauira. H.264, H.265, VP9 rānei.
convert.audioCodecHint: Ko te codec e whakamahia ana hei whakawaehere i te ia oro, hei tauira. AAC, MP3, Opus rānei.
convert.videoBitrateHint: Te pāraurau whāinga mō te ia ataata. Ko ngā uara teitei ake ka whakapiki i te kounga me te rahi kōnae. Ka pupuri te aunoa i te pāraurau puna.
convert.audioBitrateHint: Te pāraurau whāinga mō te ia oro. Ko ngā uara teitei ake ka whakapiki i te kounga me te rahi kōnae. Ka pupuri te aunoa i te pāraurau puna.
convert.qscaleHint: Tauine kounga pūmau mai i te 1 (te kounga pai rawa, te kōnae nui rawa) ki te 31 (te kounga kino rawa, te kōnae iti rawa).
convert.scaleHint: Tauritehia te ataata ki te whānui me te teitei kua hōmai, hei tauira. 1280x720. Waiho mākūkā hei pupuri i te mārama taketake.
convert.pixelFormatHint: Te hōputu tae o te ataata kua whakawaeheretia, hei tauira. yuv420p mō te 8-bit, yuv420p10le rānei mō te 10-bit. Honoa ki te puna mō te hototahitanga pai rawa.
convert.transcoderCoreHint: Te pūkaha e whakamahia ana mō te huripoka. Ko FFmpeg te kōwhiringa taunoa, ā, he tino hototahi.
convert.encoderTypeHint: Whakakapinga te momo whakawaehere i kōwhiria i ngā tautuhinga mō tēnei huripoka. E whai ana te aunoa i te uara tautuhinga.
convert.codecCompatWarning: Kāore pea te codec ataata {{codec}} e hototahi katoa ki te ipu .{{extension}}. Te toronga e taunakitia ana: .{{suggested}}

imageCompress.title: Kōmitimiti Whakaahua
imageCompress.validationRequired: Tēnā koa tīpakohia he whakaahua whakauru.
imageCompress.inputImageHint: Te whakaahua puna hei kōmitimiti. E tautokohia ana te JPEG, PNG, WebP me te BMP.
imageCompress.outputFileHint: Te wāhi hei tiaki i te whakaahua kua kōmitimiti. Ka whai te toronga i te hōputu kua tīpakohia.
imageCompress.outputFormatHint: Te hōputu e huri ai te whakaahua. Ka hoatu e te JPEG te kōnae iti rawa, ko te PNG kore-ngaro.
imageCompress.qualityHint: Kounga kōmitimiti. Ko ngā uara iti ake ka hoatu kōnae iti engari he maha ake ngā mōkito e kitea ana.
imageCompress.scaleHint: Ngā taunoa mārama putanga. Tīpakoa he rahinga paerewa, ka pupuri rānei i te taketake mā te 'Kāore he Huringa Tauine'.
imageCompress.keepAspectRatioHint: Ina whakahohe, ka pupuri te whakaahua i tōna ōwehenga taketake; ina whakamomoe, ka torona ki te mārama tika.

audioExtract.audioCodecHint: Ko te codec e whakamahia ana hei whakawaehere i te ia oro, hei tauira. AAC, MP3, Opus rānei.
audioExtract.bitrateHint: Te pāraurau whāinga mō te ia oro. Ko ngā uara teitei ake ka whakapiki i te kounga me te rahi kōnae. Ka pupuri te aunoa i te pāraurau puna.
audioExtract.validationRequired: Tēnā koa tīpakohia he kōnae ataata.
audioExtract.cancelMessage: Kei te tino hiahia koe ki te whakakore i te tohanga oro?

videoCut.title: Tapahia te Ataata
videoCut.noFile: Kāore anō kia tīpakohia he kōnae
videoCut.dropLabel: Whakatakotoria he kōnae ataata ki konei, ka pāwhiri rānei ki te tirotiro
videoCut.videoFileHint: Tōia ka whakatakoto i tētahi kōnae ataata ki konei, ka pāwhiri rānei ki te tirotiro i tō rorohiko.
videoCut.outputFileHint: Te ara e tiakina ai te ataata kua tapahia.
videoCut.startTimeHint: Te wāhi e tīmata ai te wāhanga tapahi. Ka taea hoki e koe te tō i te kakau tapahi kākāriki i te raina wā.
videoCut.durationHint: Ka mutu te wā, tohua ai te roa o te wāhanga tapahi.
videoCut.endTimeHint: Te wāhi e mutu ai te wāhanga tapahi. Ka taea hoki e koe te tō i te kakau tapahi whero i te raina wā.
videoCut.useDuration: Whakamahia te Roa, kaua te Wā Mutunga
videoCut.useDurationHint: Huri i waenga i te wā mutunga me te roa mō te wāhanga tapahi.
videoCut.cutHint: Tīmatahia te tapahi ataata me ngā tūnga tīmatanga me te mutunga kua whirihorahia.
videoCut.cancelMessage: Kei te tino hiahia koe ki te whakakore i te tapahi ataata? Ka mukua te puka.
videoCut.jobCancelMessage: Mā tēnei e muku te puka tapahi ataata o nāianei. Kei te tino mōhio koe?
videoCut.validationRequired: Tēnā koa tīpakohia he kōnae ataata.

settings.title: Tautuhinga
settings.alwaysOnTopHint: Kia noho te matapihi o te taupānga ki runga ake o ngā matapihi katoa.
settings.launchAtLoginHint: Ka tīmata aunoatia a EncodeX ina takiuru koe ki tō rorohiko.
settings.hardwareAccelerationHint: Whakamahia tō GPU (NVIDIA NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD AMF) mō te whakawaehere me te whakawehikore ataata. Whakamomoehia mō te whakawaehere pūmanawa anake.
settings.hwaccelModeHint: Aunoa: ka mahi te GPU i te whakawehikore me te whakawaehere (tere rawa, kāore e hototahi tonu). Encoder anake: ko te GPU te whakawaehere, ko te CPU te whakawehikore (haumaru rawa).
settings.encoderTypeHint: Tātari i te rārangi codec ataata. Ka whakaatu te Aunoa i ngā encoder katoa, ka whakaatu te Marohi i ngā encoder GPU anake, ka whakaatu te Pūmanawa i ngā encoder CPU anake.
